raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Rows from the new 'v2' collector have timestamps about 6 hours later than 'legacy' rows. Legacy days start around 06:00 and v2 days around 12:00, and v2 rows reach 04:10 on 01-19, which is after the 02:00 ingest. The late-evening v2 rows therefore spill into the next calendar day, which causes the 00:00-06:00 alerts and the wrong txn_date. Shifting v2 timestamps back 6 hours corrects the silver and gold tables.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, adj_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(adj_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS adj_ts FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
